collection.title: Nissan Interstar 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Interstar 2021 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
